ops.title: Builder disk 80→140 GB: empirical headroom for day-long builds
ops.body: Two ENOSPC failures in one day (2026-07-13: deploy-vm cutover attempt 1, scratch validation build) showed 80 GB insufficient for repeated hermes image builds even with in-guest nix-collect-garbage — Ubuntu base + warm /nix + per-build closures + the 2x raw->img copy. Default is now 140 GB (build-hermes-image.sh); tart set only grows, so existing builder VMs pick it up on the next run.
